instructor: Prof. Dr. Abdul Hadi Mohammed Adkhil
subject: 05_Soft_Computing

questions.question: Besides two fuzzy sets, a fuzzy relation can be built from what?
questions.question_ar: إضافة لمجموعتين ضبابيتين، من ماذا تُبنى العلاقة الضبابية؟
options: a rule over the two sets
options_en: a rule over the two sets
questions.explanation: A fuzzy relation can also be built from a rule stated over the two universes.
questions.explanation_ar: تُبنى العلاقة أيضاً من قاعدة محددة على الفضاءين.

questions.question: A fuzzy rule is stored as what?
questions.explanation: A fuzzy IF-THEN rule is stored as a relation matrix over the two universes.
questions.explanation_ar: قاعدة إذا-فإن تُخزَّن كمصفوفة علاقة على الفضاءين.

questions.question: Zadeh's max-min rule combines what?
options: only the rule rows right here
options_en: only the rule rows right here
questions.explanation: It joins the rule's rows with the complement rows, so a false premise gives one.
questions.explanation_ar: تضم صفوف القاعدة مع صفوف المتمم، فالمقدمة الخاطئة تعطي واحداً.

questions.question: The IF-THEN-ELSE relation adds what?
questions.explanation: It adds an else branch, used where the antecedent fails.
questions.explanation_ar: تضيف فرع البديل، يُستخدم حيث تفشل المقدمة.

questions.question: What does the chain rule of inference state?
questions.question_ar: ماذا تنص قاعدة التسلسل في الاستدلال؟
questions.explanation: Two implications that chain together join into a single implication.
questions.explanation_ar: الاستلزامان المتسلسلان يندمجان في استلزام واحد.

questions.question: Generalized modus tollens infers what?
options: the data from the rule here
the effect from the cause here
the rule from the data here
options_en: the data from the rule here
the effect from the cause here
the rule from the data here
questions.explanation: Generalized modus tollens goes backward, from an observed effect to its likely cause.
questions.explanation_ar: التعميم العكسي يمضي للخلف، من أثر ملاحظ إلى سببه المحتمل.

questions.question: A lambda-cut keeps which elements?
questions.explanation: A lambda-cut keeps every element whose grade reaches or exceeds lambda.
questions.explanation_ar: مقطع لامبدا يُبقي كل عنصر درجته تبلغ لامبدا أو تتجاوزها.

questions.question: Which lambda-cut property holds?
questions.explanation: The cut of a union equals the union of the cuts, and the same holds for intersection.
questions.explanation_ar: مقطع الاتحاد يساوي اتحاد المقاطع، وكذلك للتقاطع.
